_comment: Keep: active durable record — never auto-retired by age. Matched rule: active_durable_keep.
Stale: active project record past stale_after threshold. Operator must decide what to do.
warnings: record has not been updated in 100d; consider review

_comment: Retire: candidate ephemeral record past expire_after threshold. Will be retired with retire_state_record() when --apply given.
